content: If you are doing the indx install the cable clip isn't there anymore
Typo on the motor side, we are working on the right motor, not the left.

"Do not move the Main-cable-clip during the upgrade."

Do not move or do not _re_move? Is it a problem if it gets out of alignment or something? What should we do if we move it accidentally? Struggling to understand the specific reason for this warning.

replies.content: The wording was unclear here. The Main-cable-clip must stay in its original position on the cable bundle throughout the upgrade. We’ve updated the instruction to make this clear.
